features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1932: Carbon fiber ground-reaction AFO designed for enhanced gait and energy efficiency.
ENERGY-STORING SPRING SYSTEM: Absorbs and releases energy during stride to reduce strain and improve walking rhythm.
KNEE SUPPORT INTEGRATION: Longer anterior strut assists with mild knee instability and improved leg extension.
LIGHTWEIGHT CARBON BUILD: Provides reliable stability with a slim, discreet profile for everyday use.
VERSATILE LEFT OR RIGHT FIT: Adjustable dual straps ensure a secure fit for a range of users and footwear.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
